prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1102
Claimant:
Taylor Johnson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2-2-24
Claim reported by phone to the adjuster line. The caller describes being struck while turning left at an intersection and
reports a concussion, with symptoms beginning shortly after the impact.
2-16-24
Reviewed the policy file. The driver of the insured vehicle is named on the policy, and the coverage period in effect
covers the reported loss.
3-6-24
The claimant has no legal representation at this time and is handling the claim directly. Explained the documentation
needed for the injury and vehicle portions.
3-17-24
Photos of the vehicle were received from the claimant. They confirm several of the described details, though the
images do not show the full sequence of the collision.
3-31-24
Inspected the damaged areas. Most of the damage is in line with the impact described, and the force shown on the
front and side paenls fits the reported crash.
4-11-24
A few older scratches were noted on the rear bumper. They may predate this incident and will be set aside for the
repair estimate.
4-13-24
Checked for independent witnesses. None were identified at the scene, and the police report does not list any.
5-25-24
Spoke with the claimant again. The account of how the collision occurred matches what was given in the first call,
including the turning movement and the point of impact.
6-17-24
Medical records were requested. The initial treatment for the head injury fits the kind and force of the crash, and the
course of care was typical, with symptoms easing as the claimant improved.
7-15-24
Records also show treatment for the same condition well before this crash. Much of the current complaint appears to
stem from that earlier history, so this is being weighed carefully.
7-17-24
The claimant was not identified at the scene and first contacted the carrier several days after the collision. The delay
and the earlier records are noted in the file for review.
8-19-24
Nothing so far suggests the vehicle damage occurred before the coverage start date. Next steps are the repair
estimate, the full medical review, and a decision on the bodily injury portion once the records are complete.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
